description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged hybrid attacks (0.90 or 3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [ATK and MND +50% (25s)] or [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Darkness Mode I (Vayne)] and [Darkness Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Darkness Mode I (Vayne)
description.text: Darkness abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Darkness abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Darkness abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Darkness abilities, casts Dual Dark Strategy after using two equipped Darkness abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant Cast 1], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Darkness Mode II (Vayne)], removes [Dual Awoken Darkness Mode I (Vayne)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1

description.name: Dual Awoken Darkness Mode II (Vayne)

description.name: Dual Dark Strategy
